description: LocalCode coding agent inside your IDE: local models, tasks, tool approvals and code review.
serverUrl: LocalCode Desktop loopback URL. Only HTTP on 127.0.0.1, localhost or [::1] is accepted. Shared with the desktop application.
executablePath: Absolute path to an installed LocalCode executable. Empty uses the standard Windows per-user installation. Launched only by Start LocalCode.
language: Interface language. Automatic follows the Windows display language reported by LocalCode; falls back to the IDE language while disconnected.
